default.notes: A consular visa (Category B) is required before travel; some nationalities are Category C and need a consulted visa vetted by the migration institute. Confirm your category with a Guatemalan consulate.

groups.notes: CA-4 free movement — citizens of El Salvador, Honduras and Nicaragua enter Guatemala with a national ID card and no visa; the four countries form one migration zone.
Visa-free (Category A) for up to 90 days — the stay is shared across the CA-4 zone (Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua) and can be extended once at the migration institute.

GT.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Guatemalan citizens.

CN.notes: Guatemala recognises Taiwan and has no diplomatic relations with Beijing — Chinese citizens need a consulted visa vetted by the migration institute, which can take several weeks.
